articles.title: Six Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes across Gaza in a day
articles.summary: An Israeli drone strike killed a young Palestinian man and wounded several others in the Jabalia refugee camp in the northern Gaza Strip on Saturday evening, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. Citing a medical source, Wafa said the drone hit a group of Palestinians near al-Falouja cemetery, west of the camp. Medical sources in Gaza said Israeli strikes across the strip had killed six Palestinians since dawn on Saturday.
